Texas healthcare marketing

Healthcare Marketing Agency for Texas Practices, Starting in Houston and Dallas

We are a Houston-based healthcare marketing and website team that has been working since 2013. In Texas, we focus first on Houston and Dallas: specialty practices, multi-office groups, urgent care, ERs and dental practices that need their website, Google listings and campaigns to work together. This page explains what we do, how specialty and territory affect what we can offer, and where to go next.

Availability varies by specialty and ZIP code. Examples in Texas: gastroenterology is reserved in Houston and surrounding GI territories; primary care is reserved in Houston, Dallas and many surrounding cities; cardiology is reserved in several Houston-area cities and Red Oak. Reserved practices can request a complimentary audit.

Choosing the right service

How Texas practices choose the right specialty page and marketing service

Texas healthcare markets are large and fragmented. A Houston GI group, a Dallas plastic surgery practice and a freestanding ER in a suburb face different competitors and need different work. Start from your specialty, then your city, then the service you actually need.

Start with specialty

Specialty decides the content, physician pages and ad policies involved. Each of our specialty pages explains what changes for that field.

Then city and ZIP

Houston and Dallas behave differently, and our territory commitments are set by ZIP code, so city decides what we can offer.

Then the service

Some practices need a website repair, some need local listings fixed, some need ads, and many need an audit before deciding.

Compare honestly

Ask every agency the same questions: scope, who does the work, fees versus ad spend, account ownership and exit terms.

Specialty pages most relevant to Texas practices

  1. GastroenterologyHouston audit; Dallas service
  2. CardiologyHouston (partly reserved) and Dallas
  3. Plastic surgeryHouston and Dallas
  4. Primary careAudit only in Houston and Dallas
  5. Urgent care and ERExisting Texas city pages

Services

Healthcare marketing services for Texas practices

The same service set applies across specialties, adapted to each. We commit to the work and the reporting. We do not guarantee rankings, AI mentions or patient numbers.

Technical SEO and website repair

Our origin as a website repair company: speed, errors, forms, security and structure fixed first.

Local SEO for Texas offices

Google Business Profiles and office pages for each location, with consistent data across directories.

Physician, service and location pages

Pages built from your real providers, services and offices, approved by your clinical team.

Google Ads where offered

Search campaigns for chosen services, reviewed against healthcare ad policies.

AI-search readiness

Clear, consistent practice facts for AI search tools; no guaranteed mentions.

Reporting

Calls, forms and referral actions by office and campaign.

Detailed service pages: healthcare SEO, healthcare AI search optimization, and for urgent care and ERs, urgent care and ER SEO in Texas.

Process and evidence

How we work with Texas practices

Houston-area practices can meet us in person when useful; Dallas and other Texas practices work with us remotely through video meetings and shared reporting.

  1. Check eligibility

    Specialty and ZIP code against current territory commitments.

  2. Assess

    Website, listings, ads and tracking, office by office.

  3. Prioritize

    Agree an order of fixes with your administrator.

  4. Build and improve

    Foundations first, then content and campaigns.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly reporting and adjustments.

Verifiable facts

What you can check about us

  • Operating since 2013 as WevTEC, a DBA of Bizzsol LLC, registered in Texas.
  • 1,000+ websites repaired; 500+ websites designed and redesigned (separate counts).
  • Published Texas pages for urgent care, ER, dental and medical SEO.

We publish client results only with permission, a timeframe and a stated method. Where we lack that permission, we show our process instead of inventing numbers.

Questions and consultation

Texas healthcare marketing questions

For practice owners and administrators across Texas.

How do we choose a healthcare marketing agency in Texas?

Look for specialty understanding, a clear explanation of what they will and will not do, evidence you can verify, separate fees and ad spend, and account ownership in your name. Ask whether they work with a direct competitor in your ZIP codes. We do not, and we tell you if your area is reserved.

Do you serve practices outside Houston and Dallas?

Yes, selectively. We have existing pages for many Texas cities in urgent care and dental work. For specialty practices, Houston and Dallas come first; ask about other cities and we will check eligibility.

How do you coordinate marketing for groups with offices in several Texas cities?

One structure for physicians, services and offices, one Google profile and page per office, and reporting by office. Territory is checked for every office address.

What services are included?

Technical SEO and website repair, local listings, physician, service and office pages, Google Ads where offered, AI-search readiness and reporting. We scope after review.

What does reporting show?

Calls, forms and referral actions by office and campaign. Call-link clicks are not reported as completed appointments.

How is pricing set?

After review, as a scope-based proposal with management fee, ad spend paid to Google, one-time website work and optional services separated.

Do we need a healthcare marketing agency near us in Texas?

Proximity helps for Houston meetings. For most website, listing and ads work, specialty knowledge and responsiveness matter more than distance.
